_: What the fields of a game message mean, where it has been settled. The client's message and field
names are rotated (ind { fqfe, fqff, fqfg } in datos/protocolo_3.6.10.11.proto), so a field's meaning
is a finding: write how it was found -- a capture, the client's code, a fix checked in the client.
Read by the MCP's protocol_fields tool. Field numbers as the .proto has them.

ind.name: a party invitation withdrawn, told to the party

fields.2: the invitee: taken off the party's list, named second in «ui.party.invitationCancelled»

ind.settled: Checked in the 3.6.10.11 client, Keka-Bron/JondoEmu#216: sent { 2 who withdrew, 3 invitee }, the client took the inviter off his own party and wrote «Testas a annulé l'invitation de Lilia» for Lilia's own.

ilo.name: a party invitation closed, told to the invitee

fields.2: who withdrew it (or the party's host, when the invitee declined)

ilo.settled: The captures send it to whoever declines; the withdrawn invitation's popup closes with it (PartyHandler.CancelInvitationAsync), checked in the client with #216.

inq.name: withdraw a pending party invitation («Annuler l'invitation»)
inq.settled: Sent by the 3.6.10.11 client from the party display's menu, #216.

iko.name: an invitation turned down, told to the inviter
iko.settled: The captures (ConnectionProtocol.BuildInvitationWithdrawn); Koalitions found the refusal's names right in #216.

lqn.name: a text message in the chat (InfoMessage)

fields.1: its type: 0 information (free text with id 0 is written as given), 1 a warning -- with id 0 the client writes «L'erreur n°0 est survenue.» instead of the text
fields.2: the message's id in the client's list (0: free text)

lqn.settled: Checked in the 3.6.10.11 client with #208: a hero's warning sent as type 1, id 0 showed «L'erreur n°0 est survenue.»; as type 0 (ConnectionProtocol.BuildNotice) the sentence.
